previous_last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now enforces the antilag maximum activation duration as a continuous timeout. Antilag stays active only while all arming conditions are met and the elapsed time since arming is below ALSMaxDuration; once the timeout expires it stays off until the arming conditions clear and re-apply. A non-positive ALSMaxDuration now inhibits antilag, and the default duration changed from 3.5 to 3 seconds.

decisions.rationale: Antilag activation is now limited by a continuous timer. The timer starts on a false-to-true transition of the arming conditions and antilag turns off when elapsed time reaches ALSMaxDuration. After a timeout, antilag does not restart while the arming conditions remain true; they must clear and re-apply. Setting ALSMaxDuration to zero or a negative value now prevents antilag from activating, so tuners must use a positive duration. The default ALSMaxDuration changed from 3.5 to 3 seconds; existing tunes keep their stored value. Verify the duration and arming conditions on the bench before relying on antilag.

last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now invalidates a pending priming-pulse request when the ignition is switched off, so a delayed prime from an earlier key cycle cannot fire after key-off or during a later key cycle. An already-opened priming pulse is still allowed to finish and close normally. The existing Priming Pulse page is updated to describe this behavior.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU changed priming-pulse scheduling so a key-off invalidates any pending delayed prime. Previously a delayed start could still fire after the ignition was switched off, or a stale request from an earlier key cycle could run during a later one. Now a pending prime is discarded on key-off, and an already-opened pulse still receives its matching close so injectors are not left open. No tune setting changes and no user action is required; the priming delay and prime table behave as before. This is a firmware behavior change, so it applies only to builds that include it.
evidence: prime_injection.cpp: onIgnitionStateChanged now tracks m_isIgnitionOn and increments m_keyCycleGeneration under a critical section, returning early on key-off
prime_injection.cpp: onPrimeStart, onPrimeOpen and onPrimeEnd take a generation argument and reject callbacks whose generation no longer matches the current key cycle
prime_injection.h: new members m_isIgnitionOn, m_primeOpened, m_keyCycleGeneration, m_pulseGeneration; adapters changed from PrimeController* to uintptr_t generation
